description: Source code for Zephyr input long press handling, including configuration, callback, and deferred work for long press detection.

classes.name: longpress_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for long press input handling, including device references, input codes, delays, and number of codes.

classes.name: longpress_data_entry
classes.description: Data entry structure for each input code, including device reference, work item, index, and long press fired status.

methods.name: longpress_deferred
methods.description: Deferred work handler that reports a long press event when triggered.

methods.name: longpress_cb
methods.description: Callback function invoked on input events to handle press and release logic, scheduling or canceling long press detection.

methods.name: longpress_init
methods.description: Initialization function for setting up long press input handling, verifying device readiness, and initializing work items.
